name: bugzinga
description: Bazinga for bugs. Query bugs from GitHub or Azure DevOps, import their full context (branch, environment, repro steps, screenshots), then drive Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex through a rigorous reproduce → investigate → propose → fix → validate → report pipeline — while you work on something else.
author: Sunny Shaban <sunny.shaban@astera.com>

scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run build && npm run lint && npm test
